The strength of the evidence is moderate, as the scores indicate a plausible but not definitive relationship. However, the exact nature of the interaction between Azimilide and the potassium channel subfamily KQT member 1 remains uncertain, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the proposed mechanism.
